summary: House of Doge Inc. (formerly Brag House Holdings) filed an 8-K to report completion of its merger with House of Doge Inc. (Texas). Under the Merger Agreement dated Oct 12 2025, HOD merged into a wholly-owned subsidiary, with HOD shareholders receiving 64,001,726 common shares and 2.051823 Class C preferred shares (each convertible into 5M common). The filing states 75,902,985 common shares outstanding post-merger, but no per-share price, premium, or deal value is disclosed. The board has not explicitly recommended. Watch for post-merger integration and dilution impact from preferred conversion.
